title: 연결어미 한눈에: 이유·조건·대조·순서
objective: Join two sentences with the right ending for reason, condition, contrast, or order, and use the correct verb or adjective form.
summary: An overview of common Korean connecting endings for reason, condition, contrast, and order, with frequent mistakes.

task.title: Choose, join, and fix
task.line: Read each item, decide if it is about reason, condition, contrast, or order, then use the ending the instruction asks for.

forms.when: Reason. ㅏ/ㅗ stem → -아서, other stems → -어서, 하다 → 해서. No 았/었 before it; not before a request or suggestion. Use it (not -(으)니까) with thanks and apologies: 도와주셔서 감사합니다, 늦어서 미안합니다.
forms.exampleMeaning: My stomach hurt, so I went to the hospital.

forms.when: Reason, especially before a request or suggestion (-(으)세요, -(으)ㅂ시다, -(으)ㄹ까요?). Final consonant → -으니까 (먹으니까), vowel → -니까 (오니까). ㅂ irregular: ㅂ → 우 + 니까 (춥다 → 추우니까, 덥다 → 더우니까). ㄹ stem: drop ㄹ + 니까 (살다 → 사니까).
forms.exampleMeaning: It's raining, so take an umbrella.
If you have time, let's have lunch together.

forms.when: Contrast. Same for every stem; can take past 았/었 (좋았지만).
forms.exampleMeaning: Kimchi is spicy, but it's tasty.

forms.when: Contrast or background. Adjective → -(으)ㄴ데 (예쁜데, 작은데); verb and 있다/없다 → -는데 (가는데, 없는데).
forms.exampleMeaning: This bag is pretty, but it's too expensive.

forms.when: Order: do A, then do B. The two actions are separate.
forms.exampleMeaning: I wash my hands and then eat.

forms.when: Order: do A, then do B connected to A (go somewhere and do something there, meet someone and do something together).
forms.exampleMeaning: I met a friend and watched a movie with them.

forms.when: After. Verbs only. Final consonant → -은 후에 (읽은 후에), vowel → -ㄴ 후에 (끝난 후에).
forms.exampleMeaning: After class is over, I go to the library.

forms.when: Before. Verbs only. Same for every stem.
forms.exampleMeaning: I brush my teeth before I go to bed.

watchOut: 늦게 갔어서 (X) → 늦게 가서 (O): Never put 았/었 before -아서/어서. Put the past tense at the end: 늦게 가서 못 봤어요.
비가 와서 집에서 쉽시다 (X) → 비가 오니까 집에서 쉽시다 (O): Before a request or suggestion, use -(으)니까.
학교에 가고 공부해요 (X) → 학교에 가서 공부해요 (O): When you go somewhere and do the next action there, use -아서/어서, not -고.
exercises: Choose the right form: ① 저를 (도와주셔서 / 도와주시니까) 감사합니다. ② 방이 (추워서 / 추우니까) 창문을 닫을까요?
Fill in with -(으)면 or -지만: ① 감기에 ____ 따뜻한 차를 마셔 보세요. (걸리다) ② 이 노트북은 ____ 정말 가벼워요. (비싸다)
Join the two sentences with -(으)ㄴ데/는데: ① 방이 좁아요. + 깨끗해요. ② 동생은 운동을 좋아해요. + 저는 안 좋아해요.
Fill in with -(으)ㄴ 후에 or -기 전에: ① 밥을 ____ 이 약을 드세요. (먹다, after) ② 회사에 ____ 커피를 사요. (가다, before)
Find the mistake and correct it: ① 어제 친구를 만났어서 기분이 좋았어요. ② 날씨가 더워서 같이 수영하러 갑시다.
answers: ① 방이 좁은데 깨끗해요. ② 동생은 운동을 좋아하는데 저는 안 좋아해요.
① 먹은 후에 ② 가기 전에
① 만났어서 → 만나서 ② 더워서 → 더우니까
